h: Umahi challenges Peter Obi's argument that Igbos should take just four years
p: Works Minister David Umahi has questioned Peter Obi's reasoning on a single four-year term for an Igbo president, asking why others did eight years while Igbos are told to settle for four.
more: The remark adds to the debate on an Igbo presidency in 2027.
Obi's camp had not responded at the time of writing.
